acceptanceCriteria: A single versioned ReleasePlan is generated from a ReleaseRequest and its digest is consumed by every release stage.
Normal release, historical-tag recovery, post-release acceptance, close-only recovery, and independent public acceptance have disjoint validated modes and explicit allowed stage transitions.
The historical recovery mode requires immutable tag/source binding and archived recovery evidence; no unbounded temporary exception remains.
Workflow jobs no longer re-infer release semantics from raw boolean inputs after plan generation.
Malformed, contradictory, stale, foreign, or insufficient plan evidence fails before platform compilation or publication.
Repeated plan generation for the same request and repository observation is deterministic, and close is a fixed point that does not create a new close prerequisite.
Existing v0.2.104 release evidence remains byte-for-byte untouched.
goal: Implement and verify a typed ReleasePlan flow so normal release, historical-tag recovery, post-release acceptance, and close-only recovery cannot diverge across shell routing, GitHub workflow jobs, and Runtime gates.
intent: Prevent release workflow self-locking by making one versioned, identity-bound release plan the authoritative source for mode selection, source binding, recovery eligibility, and stage transitions.
outOfScope: v0.2.104 tag/release/history; Outcome rendering and assistant-message delivery; platform packaging implementation; unrelated lifecycle or verification refactors; arbitrary bypasses of source

scenarioCoverage.expected: Downstream jobs reject a missing, stale, or mismatched plan digest instead of re-inferring mode.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: raw workflow inputs cannot diverge after plan generation
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run workflow static policy and plan digest tamper fixtures.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The existing tag, release, and archived evidence are not rewritten.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare immutable release and archive digests before and after focused verification.

scenarioCoverage.expected: NormalRelease, HistoricalTagRecovery, PostReleaseAcceptance, CloseOnly, and IndependentPublicAcceptance have explicit allowed transitions.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise the typed plan transition matrix before any publication run.
